kit.intro:
Your Account Key is the only thing that can unlock your data.
Store it somewhere safe and private — a password manager, or printed and
locked away. Anyone who has it can read your chats.

What it does:
- Unlocks your encrypted chats on a new device.
- Your password only signs you in; this key unlocks your data.
kit.lose:
If you lose it:
- We keep no copy of your Account Key, so your data cannot be recovered.
